text: Threadline · 脉络（DSH 插件，Web/桌面客户端）：以只读方式展示当前工作区在会话中的演变。它读取 DSH 已记录的会话事件，在会话页嵌入文件关系图、目录卡片、轮次带和时间轴。主要功能包括查看文件关系与目录活动、按轮次筛选文件及读写状态、回看会话影响，以及通过命令跳转到视图。适合回顾长会话或了解工作区变更脉络；使用前需要 DSH 会话持久化服务和当前工作区，无需 API Key 或外部账号。

Threadline is a read-only DSH workspace map. It shows file relations, directory activity, and a turn timeline from recorded session events. Users can inspect file activity by turn and jump to the view with a command. It needs the current workspace and DSH session persistence; no API key is required.

Threadline 的功能「文件关系图」：把会话记录中被触及的文件组织为关系图和目录卡片。在会话页的脉络视图中查看，并可选择目录或轮次筛选。
Threadline 的功能「轮次时间线」：按会话轮次回看文件活动及读写行数等状态。打开脉络视图后选择轮次，即可查看对应文件范围。
Threadline 的功能「轮次影响入口」：在已完成的 assistant 消息操作区显示影响图标；点击后切换到脉络视图并聚焦对应轮次。
Threadline 的功能「会话导航命令」：输入 /threadline 或 /脉络，跳转到会话页的脉络标签并聚焦当前会话。
Threadline 的功能「分批扫描会话」：按当前会话、子智能体、近期和历史会话排序读取记录，并在界面展示进度；超出限制或读取失败时保留截断和错误状态。

Threadline · 脉络

A permanent read-only visual map of how a DeepSeek Harness workspace actually developed.

中文

dsh-plugin-control-your-development README · Overview：Threadline answers a question that chat logs do not: **what did this workspace actually go through, and what did each turn change?**

It reads what DeepSeek Harness has already recorded — sessions, subagents, tool calls, file operations, commands, background jobs — and turns it into a growing relationship map of the current workspace. Files that DSH touched become nodes, grouped by directory; turns become a strip at the bottom; every number can be traced back to a recorded event.

dsh-plugin-control-your-development README · Overview：It is **permanently read-only**. It never writes to your workspace, your session logs or your settings, never calls a model, and never makes an outbound request. It cannot start, stop or retry anything — there is deliberately no control surface at all.

Typical use: you come back to a long session, or hand a workspace to someone else, and want to see where the work went.

dsh-plugin-control-your-development README · Features：- **File relation map (left)** — the most active directory of the current session by default. Pick any directory card to switch; pick a turn to switch to the files touched by that turn across directories. Deterministic radial layout, no pan/zoom, no cluster boxes, no grid. Node colour = five file families (text / code / data / media / other).
- **Directory cards (right, two columns)** — name, file count, current-turn badge, operations / last activity, five-family bar, top 3 active files. Same screen as the map, one page scroll; stacks below 960px.
- **Turn status only from recorded facts** — `read N`, `write +A / −D lines`, `first seen`; file-level deletion/creation is not provable and is not shown. The summary bar is fixed to one line: `read N · write +A/−D lines · first seen F · deletes C` (full wording in the tooltip).
- **Two-way hover linking** — hover a card to preview its directory; hover a node to highlight its directory card and related turns; hover a turn to preview that turn's files and highlight related cards. Hover only previews; it never changes the click selection or scroll position.

dsh-plugin-control-your-development README · Installation：Requirements: DeepSeek Harness **0.2.2-rc.1** or newer, on a desktop or web profile.

Install it as a DSH plugin from npm:

```text
Plugin manager → Add plugin → dsh-plugin-control-your-development@1.0.0
```

Or install into a profile directly:

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-control-your-development@1.0.0 --profile desktop
```

Then reload the page (client code) or restart DSH (host code).

dsh-plugin-control-your-development README · Installation：> Installed DSH plugins do not update automatically. Upgrading means uninstalling and installing the new version — this is a DSH behaviour, not a Threadline one.

dsh-plugin-control-your-development README · Usage：Open a conversation and pick the **Threadline** tab next to chat / trajectory. The tab fills the conversation area and scrolls on its own; the composer is hidden while you are in it and returns when you leave.

dsh-plugin-control-your-development README · Usage：- The left map shows the current directory; pick another directory card to switch, or a turn block to switch to that turn's file map with status.
- Hovering a card, node or turn previews and cross-highlights; clicking pins the selection; leaving the whole tab restores it.
- The timeline plays the workspace back in time; ranges are **today / 7 days / 30 days / all**.
- `/threadline` jumps to the tab; the per-turn impact icon jumps and focuses that turn.

dsh-plugin-control-your-development README · Usage：

Threadline only reads the workspace the current session belongs to. Sessions from other workspaces, profiles or machines are not aggregated.

dsh-plugin-control-your-development README · Configuration：None. There is no configuration file, no setting, no stored preference and no cached artefact — all filters, selections and time ranges live in memory and reset when you reload. The only thing it needs is the workspace it is already in.
